reading.body:
Poolside is a foundation model company whose one disclosed technical result is a 6, 13% training throughput gain on NVIDIA Grace superchips by offloading MLP activations to host memory.

Poolside describes itself as building open-weight foundation models and has released the first two Laguna models, M.1 and XS.2, along with a runtime for training and operating agents. Those models are offered through two product experiences in research preview. The disclosed research is about training efficiency on NVIDIA Grace-based superchips, using NVLink C2C as an alternative to selective activation checkpointing, with negligible memory overhead.

The available facts do not include model sizes, parameter counts, energy use, or any connection to grid or building constraints. No litigation, no MCP servers, and no tracked products appear in the facts held about the company, so the compute footprint beyond this one hardware-specific result is unknown.

profile_text.body:
Poolside describes itself as a foundation model company bringing intelligence to everywhere work gets done, with a stated mission of driving abundance for humanity by creating artificial general intelligence. The company says it is building open-weight foundation models along with the systems that refine and improve them, and that it works in the open, publishing research, engineering, and ideas.

On its own account, Poolside has released the first two models in the Laguna family, Laguna M.1 and Laguna XS.2, together with the runtime it uses to train and operate agents. Those are offered through two product experiences in research preview. The site also presents a research result on using NVIDIA's NVLink C2C on Grace-based superchips as a high-performance alternative to selective activation checkpointing, reporting that offloading MLP activations to host memory during training yields a 6-13% throughput improvement over selective AC with negligible memory overhead.

No litigation, no MCP servers, and no tracked products appear in the facts held about the company.
